text:
alex: Heads-up: product asked if we can support CI-triggered temporary inspect tokens (for integration tests) without opening PII risk. Need a protocol before they ship.
mira: Idea: short-lived inspect tokens issued by tenant owners via console or API, limited scope (routes + time), and always consume inspect credits.
ben: Important: tokens must be bound to a purpose and git/ci job id. No free-form tokens that devs can hand out.
sre-zoe: Operational constraints: token TTL max 2h, default 15m, single-use by default, and rate-limited. Emissions count against tenant inspect_credits.
privacy-bot: POLICY: tokens cannot enable capturing attachments or embeddings by default. High-sensitivity captures require explicit owner approval and legal ack.
alex: Flow sketch: owner requests token -> selects routes and sensitivity -> owner approves -> token minted with approval_id and attached to credits. Token returns masked preview only.
mira: For audit: every token issuance must create immutable ledger entry with issuer, repo/job, justification, expiry. Ledger entries searchable.
ben: Token binding to CI: token should include `job_hash` and `commit_sha`. If job_hash mismatch at use, reject and emit suspicious-usage alert.
sre-zoe: Replay safety: tokens are single-use unless owner checks "allow multiple uses" box. Single-use preferred for CI to avoid leaks.
alex: Developer UX: console shows active tokens, which job used them, remaining credit consumption, and a revoke button.
mira: Security: token payload in logs should not contain raw job names or commit content, only hashed job_id and commit_sha fingerprint (HMAC per-tenant).
ben: Also add TTL on captured payloads created by a token: default 7 days (shorter than manual inspect). Legal can request extension via legal-hold API.
privacy-bot: REMINDER: embeddings/files created via a token are disallowed unless owner explicitly enables and signs acceptance (checkbox + ratified email).
sre-zoe: Routing note: if token originates from CI in a different region, route capture to tenant's home region for storage to comply with data residency.
amelia: (joining) Quick question: how do we ensure test data doesn't get treated as production? We should allow tenants to tag tokens as `test_data=true`, which reduces retention and forbids export.
alex: Good call. Token schema includes `test_mode:true|false`. Test_mode reduces TTL to 3d and forbids SRE-mediated exports (only owner can request).
mira: Edgecase: leaked token used by another tenant. Mitigation: tokens are tenant-scoped, bound to tenant_id and HMACed job_hash. Cross-tenant use rejected.
ben: Envelope shape suggestion (metadata-only keys as strings): env:v1, tenant:t-xx, event:inspect.token_capture, token_id:tk-123, sample_reason:ci:test, fingerprint:hmac-v1:abcd, sensitivity:medium, summary:"truncated".
sre-zoe: Metrics we need: token_issue_rate, token_use_rate, token_revoke_count, token_denied_mismatch. Also per-tenant inspect_credit_burn_by_token.
privacy-bot: Compliance: require RFC + a canary with two tenants (one internal) before enabling. Also require a short training doc for owners on risks.
amelia: UX asks: list tokens by job, show recent uses, show credit burn per use, and clearly mark test tokens in UI to prevent accidental export.
alex: Action items: mira -> draft token schema + API shape; ben -> add CI binding checks and alert rules; sre-zoe -> runbook + metrics + regional routing; privacy-bot -> compliance checklist + owner training doc.
ben: will also add a CLI helper that lets CI request token and print masked token to stdout (avoid logging raw token).
mira: Put behind flag `feature:ci_inspect_tokens_v1` and test with internal tenant first. RFC link when ready.
privacy-bot: NOTE: RFC must include sample abuse scenarios and revocation procedures.
sre-zoe: I'll schedule a 30m ops review after RFC lands.
alex: RFC posted: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/r/ci-inspect-tokens-v1 -- feedback welcome.
